short.t: Intimate wedding celebrations for couples who want something deeply personal and beautifully simple.

intro.0.t: Elopement weddings are intimate celebrations designed around what truly matters. A beautiful place. The person you love. Your closest people. And a day that feels entirely yours.

intro.1.t: PICNIC CLUB creates intimate elopement experiences throughout Portugal, from location scouting and styling to food, flowers and the smallest details — for two, or for a very close circle of loved ones.

included.1.t: Ceremony styling: the arch, the aisle and the flowers

included.2.t: A table for the celebration afterwards

included.3.t: The smallest details, from the rings to the signage

included.4.t: Coordination on the day, so you can simply be there

seo.title.t: Elopement weddings in Portugal and Comporta · Picnic Club

seo.description.t: Intimate elopement weddings in Portugal: ceremony styling, flowers, a private celebration and every detail cared for, from Comporta to Lisbon.
